rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for rap music and an individual rap song or verse.

example.english: I listen to rap music all the time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jat6 teng1 jiu4 sit6 jam1 ngok6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for chatting casually.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 go2 zan6 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this for striking or knocking something sharply, especially with the knuckles.

example.jyutping: nei5 haau1 haa5 mun4 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for the casual chat or conversation itself.

example.english: We had a casual rap after dinner.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zo6 dai1 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this for one sharp, forceful blow with something hard.

example.english: I took a rap from a hammer and dropped to my knees.
example.traditional: 我畀鐵鎚一記重擊，痛到跪低。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 tit3 ceoi4 jat1 gei3 cung5 gik1 tung3 dou3 gwai6 dai1

rows.note: Use this for performing lyrics in a rap-music style rather than for ordinary talking.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 toi4 soeng6 coeng3 jiu4 sit6 go1

rows.note: Use this for the blame or responsibility someone is expected to take.

example.english: The contractor has to take the rap for this accident.
example.traditional: 呢單意外嘅責任要由承辦商孭起。
example.jyutping: nei1 daan1 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 zaak3 jam6 jiu3 jau4 sing4 baan6 soeng1 me1 hei2
